entries.title: Proverbs 21:1
segments: The king's heart is in the hand of Jehovah as the watercourses: He turneth it whithersoever he will.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:2
segments: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes; But Jehovah weigheth the hearts.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:3
segments: To do righteousness and justice Is more acceptable to Jehovah than sacrifice.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:4
segments: A high look, and a proud heart, [Even] the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:5
segments: The thoughts of the diligent [tend] only to plenteousness; But every one that is hasty [hasteth] only to want.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:6
segments: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue Is a vapor driven to and fro by them that seek death.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:7
segments: The violence of the wicked shall sweep them away, Because they refuse to do justice.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:8
segments: The way of him that is laden with guilt is exceeding crooked; But as for the pure, his work is right.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:9
segments: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, Than with a contentious woman in a wide house.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:10
segments: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: His neighbor findeth no favor in his eyes.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:11
segments: When the scoffer is punished, the simple is made wise; And when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:12
segments: The righteous man considereth the house of the wicked, [How] the wicked are overthrown to [their] ruin.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:13
segments: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, He also shall cry, but shall not be heard.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:14
segments: A gift in secret pacifieth anger; And a present in the bosom, strong wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:15
segments: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; But it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:16
segments: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding Shall rest in the assembly of the dead.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:17
segments: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: He that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:18
segments: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous; And the treacherous [cometh] in the stead of the upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:19
segments: It is better to dwell in a desert land, Than with a contentious and fretful woman.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:20
segments: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; But a foolish man swalloweth it up.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:21
segments: He that followeth after righteousness and kindness Findeth life, righteousness, and honor.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:22
segments: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, And bringeth down the strength of the confidence thereof.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:23
segments: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue Keepeth his soul from troubles.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:24
segments: The proud and haughty man, scoffer is his name; He worketh in the arrogance of pride.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:25
segments: The desire of the sluggard killeth him; For his hands refuse to labor.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:26
segments: There is that coveteth greedily all the day long; But the righteous giveth and withholdeth not.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:27
segments: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination: How much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind!

entries.title: Proverbs 21:28
segments: A false witness shall perish; But the man that heareth shall speak so as to endure.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:29
segments: A wicked man hardeneth his face; But as for the upright, he establisheth his ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:30
segments: There is no wisdom nor understanding Nor counsel against Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:31
segments: The horse is prepared against the day of battle; But victory is of Jehovah.
